question: Do the six minimum public TIFF rows decode cleanly and verify the contact-sheet file ordering plus three explicit cross-stock exposure roles without fitting or scoring colour response?

execution_amendment.reason: Pre-formal BU7 inspection found that pypdf's convenience image conversion byte-interleaves the PDF's 16-bit ICCBased samples and enumerates resources out of displayed object order. BU6 was rerun using direct big-endian samples sorted by PDF object ID before any BU7 report was accepted.

decode.contact_match: resize TIFF RGB to the exact embedded contact image dimensions with OpenCV INTER_AREA, convert both to float64 grayscale gradients, and compute normalized correlation

rights.allowed_use: local quarantined internal research integrity and role audit only

forbidden: download any non-listed still, PDF or video payload in this leaf
repair a failed file-order mapping after pixels are read
fit or score any colour operator or infer stock response
treat an ICC profile as scanner, process, stock-response or calibration evidence
treat a downloadable link as redistribution or commercial-product permission

branch_rule.pass: Open a separately frozen source-matched colour-statistic discriminant with nuisance controls and a held-out role; do not fit a product operator.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact TIFF mapping/integrity route without downloading further rows.

claim_ceiling: Exact pixel integrity and role mapping for six author-rendered 16mm TIFFs from one comparison; not neutral digital/film pairing, scanner/process calibration, stock response, reusable operator or product evidence.
